'''Burrfruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was native to the planet [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. It was purple in color and considered to be sweet. The colony of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] on Maridun gathered burrfruit in large baskets for food.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Burr (fruit)|Burr]] is an actual type of fruit.
